title: Dapagliflozin vs placebo for cardiovascular death or worsening heart failure in HFmrEF/HFpEF
question: In adults with heart failure and mildly reduced or preserved ejection fraction, does dapagliflozin reduce the composite of cardiovascular death or worsening heart failure versus placebo? (Double-blind placebo-controlled RCTs; HR estimand.)
